description: This file defines the StreamIdentity class, which provides a way to uniquely identify a stream within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for a GUID and namespace, and overrides equality and hash code methods.

classes.name: StreamIdentity
classes.description: A class representing the identity of a stream, including a GUID and namespace, used for uniquely identifying streams within a provider.

methods.name: StreamIdentity
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a GUID and namespace.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare stream identities based on GUID and namespace.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.GetHashCode to generate a hash code based on GUID and namespace.
